mapper.sql: ap_schedules.id AS id, branches.id AS branchId, branches.name AS branchName, CONCAT(ap_schedules.start_date, ' ', ap_schedules.start_time ) AS startDate, CONCAT(ap_schedules.end_date, ' ', ap_schedules.end_time ) AS endDate, ap_schedules.title AS title, ap_schedules.backgroundColor AS backgroundColor, ap_schedules.privacy AS privacy, DATE_FORMAT(ap_schedules.created, '%d-%b-%y %h:%i') AS createdDate, DATE_FORMAT(ap_schedules.modified, '%d-%b-%y %h:%i') AS modifiedDate, CONCAT(users1.first_name, ' ', users1.last_name ) AS createdBy, CONCAT(users2.first_name, ' ', users2.last_name ) AS modifiedBy

FROM ap_schedules LEFT JOIN branches ON branches.id = ap_schedules.branch_id LEFT JOIN users AS users1 ON users1.id = ap_schedules.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS users2 ON users2.id = ap_schedules.modified_by
mapper.select: SELECT purchase_orders.id AS id, purchase_orders.po_code AS name, purchase_orders.balance AS amountDue, (SELECT name FROM vendors WHERE id = purchase_orders.vendor_id) AS vendorName FROM ap_schedule_details LEFT JOIN purchase_orders ON purchase_orders.id = ap_schedule_details.purchase_order_id WHERE ap_schedule_details.ap_schedule_id = #{apScheduleId} AND ap_schedule_details.is_active = 1 LIMIT 1;
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ap_schedules( branch_id, start_date, start_time, end_date, end_time, title, backgroundColor, privacy, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{apSchedule.branchId}, #{apSchedule.startDate}, #{apSchedule.startTime}, #{apSchedule.endDate}, #{apSchedule.endTime}, #{apSchedule.title}, #{apSchedule.backgroundColor}, #{apSchedule.privacy}, NOW(), #{apSchedule.createdBy}, #{apSchedule.isActive} );
INSERT INTO ap_schedule_details (ap_schedule_id, purchase_order_id, amount_due) VALUES (#{apScheduleDetails.apScheduleId}, #{apScheduleDetails.purchasesOrderId}, #{apScheduleDetails.amountDue});
mapper.update: UPDATE ap_schedule_details SET is_active = 2 WHERE ap_schedule_id = #{apScheduleId};

UPDATE ap_schedules SET `branch_id` = #{apSchedule.branchId}, `start_date` = #{apSchedule.startDate}, `end_date` = #{apSchedule.endDate}, `start_time` = #{apSchedule.startTime}, `end_time` = #{apSchedule.endTime}, `title` = #{apSchedule.title}, `backgroundColor` = #{apSchedule.backgroundColor}, `privacy` = #{apSchedule.privacy}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{apSchedule.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{apSchedule.id}
